page.overview:
What is Long Sword?

The [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Longsword Longsword] (sometimes spelled Long Sword or Long-sword) is a type of European sword used during the late Medieval period.

Scorpion uses a Long Sword in Mortal Kombat 4. Sub-Zero used the same Long Sword in early versions of the game, although it was eventually switched for the Ice Scepter.

Mileena used a differently designed Long Sword in Mortal Kombat Gold, although the weapon behaved identically to its original design.

Spawn uses a Longsword in his forward grab and in a special move and uses them in one of his brutalities in Mortal Kombat 11.
